cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(cameo_family VERSION 1.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH_USE_ORIGIN ON)
set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH ON)
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN;$ORIGIN/../lib;$ORIGIN/linear-algebra")
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
option(CF_ASAN "ASan+UBSan" OFF)
option(CF_TSAN "TSan" OFF)
option(CF_FUZZ "Clang libFuzzer" OFF)
if(CF_ASAN AND CF_TSAN)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Separate sanitizer builds required")
endif()
add_compile_options(-ffp-contract=off "-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}=cf-source" "-ffile-prefix-map=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}=cf-build")
if(CF_ASAN)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
elseif(CF_TSAN)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=thread)
endif()
find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED)
include(cmake/source_lapack.cmake)
add_library(cf_pocketfft STATIC vendor/pocketfft/pocketfft.c)
target_include_directories(cf_pocketfft PUBLIC vendor/pocketfft)
set(CF_SOURCES src/acf.cpp src/linear_algebra.cpp src/swab.cpp src/frequency.cpp src/raw.cpp src/numpy_sort.cpp src/api.cpp)
foreach(t cameo_family cameo_family_static)
 if(t STREQUAL "cameo_family")
  add_library(${t} SHARED ${CF_SOURCES})
 else()
  add_library(${t} STATIC ${CF_SOURCES})
 endif()
 target_include_directories(${t} PUBLIC include PRIVATE vendor/pocketfft)
 target_compile_definitions(${t} PRIVATE CF_DGELSD=${CF_DGELSD_SYMBOL})
 target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
 target_link_libraries(${t} PRIVATE cf_pocketfft OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX cf_lapack)
 target_link_options(${t} PRIVATE -Wl,--disable-new-dtags)
 set_target_properties(${t} PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN/linear-algebra")
endforeach()
add_executable(cameo_cli tools/cli.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cameo_cli PRIVATE cameo_family)
set_target_properties(cameo_cli PROPERTIES INSTALL_RPATH "$ORIGIN;$ORIGIN/../lib")
include(CTest)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
 add_executable(cf_native_tests tests/native.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(cf_native_tests PRIVATE cameo_family)
 if(CF_TSAN AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  target_compile_definitions(cf_native_tests PRIVATE CF_NO_ALLOC_INJECTION=1)
 endif()
 add_test(NAME native_safety COMMAND cf_native_tests)
 add_executable(cf_numeric_tests tests/numeric_safety.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(cf_numeric_tests PRIVATE cameo_family)
 add_test(NAME numerical_dependency COMMAND cf_numeric_tests)
 add_executable(cf_performance tests/performance.cpp)
 target_include_directories(cf_performance PRIVATE tools)
 target_link_libraries(cf_performance PRIVATE cameo_family)
 add_executable(cf_transform_tests tests/transform.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(cf_transform_tests PRIVATE cameo_family)
 add_test(NAME transform_parity COMMAND cf_transform_tests --check)
endif()
install(TARGETS cameo_family cameo_family_static cf_pocketfft cameo_cli LIBRARY DESTINATION lib ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES include/cameo_family.hpp include/cameo_family_c.h DESTINATION include)

if(CF_FUZZ)
 if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "CF_FUZZ requires Clang")
 endif()
 target_compile_options(cameo_family PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
 target_compile_options(cf_pocketfft PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
 add_executable(cf_fuzz tests/fuzz.cpp)
 target_compile_options(cf_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
 target_link_options(cf_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
 target_link_libraries(cf_fuzz PRIVATE cameo_family)
endif()

install(FILES "${CF_LAPACK_LIBRARY}" DESTINATION lib RENAME libcf_lapack.a)
install(DIRECTORY LICENSES/ DESTINATION share/cameo-family/LICENSES)
install(FILES NOTICE.md docs/API.md docs/CONTRACT.md DESTINATION share/cameo-family)
